policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM club_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = clubs.id) AND (cm.is_active = true) AND (cm.role = 'main_admin'::text) AND ((cm.profile_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM player_profiles pp
          WHERE ((pp.id = cm.player_profile_id) AND (pp.linked_auth_user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))))))
